metadata.purpose: Six intentionally difficult exposed extraction controls; no review-grade or population-accuracy claim.
metadata.runtimeInputBoundary: Only case.input.learnerResponse may be passed to the extractor. References and annotations are evaluator-only.
metadata.annotationPolicy: Semantic obligations are schema-neutral. Exact occurrence validation is separate from faithful interpretation. A faithful representation may use equivalent structure but must preserve every obligation without invented active claims. Unresolved on a required explicit positive obligation is withholding, not success.
metadata.reservePolicy: Only exposed fresh-v2 was read. The sealed fresh-v3 remains unread and is ineligible for this Qwen route.

input.learnerResponse: Two aircraft are involved, TRN102 and TRN103: one of them occupies Stand B and the other is waiting for it.

exactWitnesses.text: TRN102 and TRN103

semanticObligations.meaning: Two distinct aircraft are mentioned; neither role is assigned to a specific aircraft.

exactWitnesses.text: one of them occupies Stand B

semanticObligations.meaning: An unspecified member of the two-aircraft set occupies Stand B.

exactWitnesses.text: the other is waiting for it

semanticObligations.meaning: The different member waits for the same Stand B; it refers to the stand, not an aircraft.

constraints: occupier and waiter are different aircraft

mustNotInfer: Do not assign TRN102 or TRN103 to either role from identifier order.
Do not invent a report, clearance, current time, or a third aircraft.

input.learnerResponse: TRN102's newest off-block target reads 10:35 — wait, let me correct that: it is 10:20. A TOBT only estimates off-block timing and grants no permission to depart.

exactWitnesses.text: TRN102's newest off-block target reads 10:35

semanticObligations.meaning: The initially mentioned current target value is withdrawn by the following explicit correction.

exactWitnesses.text: wait, let me correct that: it is 10:20

semanticObligations.meaning: The replacement 10:20 is the active current target for the same aircraft/property; it refers to that target.

exactWitnesses.text: A TOBT only estimates off-block timing

semanticObligations.meaning: A generic target off-block time is an estimate of off-block timing.

exactWitnesses.text: grants no permission to depart

semanticObligations.meaning: A TOBT does not confer departure permission; this does not deny actual permission.

mustNotInfer: Do not retain 10:35 as the active current target.
Do not discard the correction because 10:35 appears first.
Do not convert non-conferral by an estimate into actual permission denied.

input.learnerResponse: Readiness, yes: with fuel, bags and the hold all sorted, TRN102 is ready to depart. Only its takeoff clearance remains unconfirmed.

exactWitnesses.text: with fuel, bags and the hold all sorted

semanticObligations.meaning: Fuel, baggage and the hold are described as sorted; this is the learner-stated basis for readiness.

exactWitnesses.text: TRN102 is ready to depart

semanticObligations.meaning: The learner affirmatively asserts readiness now, even if later evidence would dispute it.

exactWitnesses.text: Only its takeoff clearance remains unconfirmed.

semanticObligations.meaning: Takeoff-clearance confirmation remains unknown for TRN102; only scopes this as the remaining unknown.

mustNotInfer: Do not correct asserted readiness into readiness unconfirmed.
Do not turn unconfirmed clearance into denial of clearance.
Do not invent a list of departure prerequisites.
Do not require sorted to mean an explicitly stated ground-hold release.

input.learnerResponse: TRN101 has not been released: it is still held at its stand, and nothing gives it departure clearance. The tower has put low-visibility procedures in force.

exactWitnesses.text: TRN101 has not been released

semanticObligations.meaning: The learner denies release of TRN101.

exactWitnesses.text: it is still held at its stand

semanticObligations.meaning: TRN101 remains held at its stand; no stand identifier is supplied.

exactWitnesses.text: nothing gives it departure clearance

semanticObligations.meaning: No departure-clearance conferral is established by the stated situation; this is not an explicit denial by an authority.

exactWitnesses.text: The tower has put low-visibility procedures in force.

semanticObligations.meaning: The tower is attributed the action of putting low-visibility procedures in force.

mustNotInfer: Do not create any safeguarding claim: safeguarding is absent from the answer.
Do not identify the unnamed stand from a question or report.
Do not infer takeoff clearance denied or a future release.

input.learnerResponse: Airside Operations now confirms safeguarding is cancelled, and with that TRN101 holds a departure clearance; it is only staying parked until a pushback slot opens.

exactWitnesses.text: Airside Operations now confirms safeguarding is cancelled

semanticObligations.meaning: Current safeguarding cancellation is attributed to Airside Operations confirmation.

exactWitnesses.text: with that TRN101 holds a departure clearance

semanticObligations.meaning: The learner asserts positive departure clearance and links it to the cancellation confirmation.

exactWitnesses.text: it is only staying parked

semanticObligations.meaning: TRN101 is currently parked; only qualifies the reason or duration, not clearance uncertainty.

exactWitnesses.text: until a pushback slot opens

semanticObligations.meaning: A slot opening is a condition for ending the parked/waiting state, not an event already reported to have occurred.

mustNotInfer: Do not omit the clearance claim or replace it with unconfirmed clearance.
Do not omit the learner-stated pushback-slot explanation.
Do not assert the slot has opened, pushback has started, or the aircraft has departed.
Do not import report truth to repair the learner assertion.

input.learnerResponse: TRN103 — no, sorry, TRN102 — is the one being held up by the late bags. Its refuelling has been completed, but nothing received yet says those bags have been loaded.

exactWitnesses.text: TRN103 — no, sorry, TRN102 —

semanticObligations.meaning: The subject identifier is repaired before its predicate: TRN103 is withdrawn, TRN102 is the active actor.

exactWitnesses.text: is the one being held up by the late bags

semanticObligations.meaning: TRN102 is delayed by late bags; ordinary delay wording need not assert a separately formal ground-hold authorization state.

exactWitnesses.text: Its refuelling has been completed

semanticObligations.meaning: Completed refuelling is asserted for the corrected actor TRN102.

exactWitnesses.text: nothing received yet says those bags have been loaded

semanticObligations.meaning: The received information does not confirm loading completion for the previously mentioned bags; this does not assert actual noncompletion.

exactWitnesses.text: but nothing received yet says those bags have been loaded

semanticObligations.meaning: Known refuelling completion is contrasted with lack of received baggage-loading confirmation.

mustNotInfer: Do not leave both TRN103 and TRN102 as competing active actors.
Do not fabricate a completed prior assertion about TRN103 when the repair is only in the subject.
Do not convert lack of loading confirmation into factual baggage noncompletion.
Do not add departure readiness or clearance.
